task_instance: Harden a minimal production Better Auth setup: starting from a basic auth.ts (email+password plus a GitHub social provider), produce a production-ready hardened configuration applying the skill's security best practices (secret management, rate limiting, CSRF, trusted origins, session/cookie security, OAuth token encryption, IP tracking, background tasks, and audit logging), and verify it against the skill's deployment security checklist.
evidence: Read SKILL.md (self-contained reference guide; no bundled scripts/templates referenced, so nothing missing). Created sample input at input/auth.ts (a minimal, un-hardened config). Produced the deliverable auth.hardened.ts applying every security area the skill covers: env-based secret with the documented generation step; https baseURL and explicit trustedOrigins; rate limiting with persistent storage and tightened custom rules on sign-in/sign-up/change-password; session expiry/updateAge/freshAge plus encrypted (jwe) cookie cache; account.encryptOAuthTokens; advanced block with useSecureCookies, cookiePrefix, sameSite, ipAddress headers and ipv6Subnet, and a serverless backgroundTasks handler; CSRF kept enabled; and databaseHooks for session/user/account audit logging. Verified in security-review.md by mapping the before/after against each item of the skill's production Security Checklist (10 items) and confirming all are satisfied. Deliverable is a TypeScript text file, which the office-assistant runtime can fully author and inspect; no code execution or binary output required. Files produced: input/auth.ts, auth.hardened.ts, security-review.md, result.json.
